mechanism: Bumetanide may cause hypotension and electrolyte depletion, while brimonidine ophthalmic can cause systemic hypotension and CNS depression when absorbed; combined effects increase risk of excessive hypotension and syncope.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly and counsel patient on orthostatic precautions; brimonidine ophthalmic absorption is generally minimal but caution is warranted in patients already on antihypertensive therapy.
